plugins.name: wizard-frontend-boilerplate-pro
plugins.description: A seven-phase scaffolding skill that takes you from zero to a fully themed, component-showcased frontend app in one session. Supports Next.js 15, React + Vite, Vue 3.5+, Nuxt 4, and SvelteKit (Svelte 5). Features 28 UI components across 6 categories, OKLCH palette generator with 8 presets, three-layer CSS variable token system, light/dark mode with FOUC prevention, Tailwind v4 support, and WCAG AA contrast validation. Optional pairing with ui-ux-pro-max for higher-fidelity component output — falls back to built-in Tailwind implementations when absent. Plain CommonMark only, all actions are shell commands or file writes.
